cpu: Intel Core i5-13600K, logical CPU 2 pinned; frequency not locked
baseline: Current working tree at start of turn, plus only split-prefix optional-space bug fix; original uncorrected implementation also measured in step2.csv
step1: Default-enabled optional simdutf8 >=256 bytes with std error fallback, and exact initial SSE encoding capacity
step2: Step1 plus compact-copy only if staging capacity >4096 and payload length <capacity/4; transfer other outputs and reserve next buffer as before
cases: 28 decode shapes/chunk patterns and 5 encoding cases; single-line JSON remains an opaque SSE payload
interleaved_method: 31 randomized interleaved rounds; per-variant warmed blocks target 3ms; paired ratios within same round; Bytes + tokio_stream::iter
quantiles: p10/p90 are paired-ratio empirical quantiles, not confidence intervals
encoding_scope: Interleaved encode_owned includes cloning strings to construct an owned Sse. Criterion encoding excludes event cloning via iter_batched; neither includes JSON serialization.
criterion_method: Full suite, 40 samples, 150ms warmup, 700ms measurement target, 10000 bootstrap resamples; selected concerns retested with rotated order and 50 samples, 200ms warmup, 1s target
memory_metric: Allocation requests and sum of output String capacities, not process RSS. Large staging buffer retained per decoder; consumers drop outputs immediately in allocation probe.
rejected_candidates: data_only excludes SIMD checks from metadata; cold_copy outlines compact copying. Neither improved the measured tradeoffs; not applied.
tests: all-features: 41 parser/encoding integration tests, 2 local HTTP integration tests of 100000 events each, 3 doctests
memchr-only and simdutf8-only: all 3 extended UTF-8 tests each
limits: No ARM performance measurement, no long-lived concurrent network latency/RSS benchmark, no Miri or sustained fuzzing
borrowed_diagnostic: Eight representative workloads using borrowed slices plus futures ready input; both ownership and Pending behavior differ from Bytes/Tokio, not an isolated attribution experiment.
criterion_runs: full: baseline,step1,step2,core; 28 decoding and 5 encoding scenarios
